features.statement: Body prose is set in a serif face (Georgia) while headings, nav and UI use a system sans-serif stack.
The main headline is very large, bold, white sans-serif over a dark hero background.
Hero tagline is set in italic serif beneath the headline.
Small uppercase labels with wide letter-spacing are used for form labels, section eyebrows and footer headings.
Section eyebrow text is colored in the accent color above a dark heading.
Palette is warm cream background, near-black text and a single rust/brick-red accent color.
Muted beige text color is used on dark surfaces such as the CTA band and footer.
Sections alternate between white, cream, dark photo and black backgrounds to separate bands.
A notice is styled as a tan callout panel with a thick accent-colored left border and rounded corners.
Header is a white bar with logo left, a few text nav links, and an accent-colored phone button right.
Hero is a two-column split with headline block on the left and a form card on the right.
Booking form uses native inputs, date pickers and selects, with fields arranged in one, two and three column rows.
Form submit is a full-width accent-colored button followed by an underlined accent text link.
Quick-link tiles in a multi-column grid have cream fill, thin border, bold label and accent arrow glyph.
A full-width black CTA band has a centered large heading, phone number and an accent-colored button.
Cards are white with thin tan borders and rounded corners, in a two-column grid with small date, bold title and serif body.
Footer is a multi-column grid of labeled link groups with a thin divider above a copyright row.
Content sits in a centered container of about 1080px with consistently aligned left edges.
CSS grid is used more than flexbox for layout.
A short two-column section pairs serif prose with a hairline-divided list.
Prose paragraphs are constrained to a narrower measure than the container, leaving the opposite side empty.
Hero uses a darkened photographic background with a gradient overlay rather than an img element.
A short accent-colored rule sits under the main headline as a decorative divider.
Decorative effects are minimal: few shadows, one gradient, simple transitions, no animations, transforms or blur.
No SVG icons are used; glyphs such as arrows are text characters.
Logo image has an empty alt attribute, marking it as decorative.
Page uses semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, sections, articles, footer) with a single h1.
Head is minimal: charset, viewport and description meta only, with no structured data.
Class usage is light and non-utility-based, with some inline styles.
Copy is short and plain, with occasional exclamation-mark headings, no emoji and no em dashes.
The phone number is repeated in header, CTA band and footer as a persistent contact point.
Link and button labels are brief, with arrows or ellipses such as 'Keep reading...'.
